description: This file defines a class 'DeploymentStatusProcessor' that interacts with the GitHub API to update deployment statuses and handle deployment success workflows. It includes interfaces for deployment response data and methods for updating deployment statuses and processing deployment success based on environment and SHA.

classes.name: DeploymentStatusProcessor
classes.description: A class responsible for managing deployment status updates via GitHub API, including updating deployment statuses and handling deployment success logic based on environment and SHA.

methods.name: updateDeploymentStatus
methods.description: Updates the deployment status on GitHub for a specific environment and deployment ID, returning a response object with deployment details.

methods.name: updateDeploymentSuccess
methods.description: Marks deployments as successful for a given SHA and environment, updating statuses for matching deployments.
